You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many small bags of M&M can John make? John buys 3 large bags of M&M weighing 10 ounces each. Each ounce of M&M contains 30 M&M. John puts 10 M&M in each small bag. John pays $0.40 per ounce for the M&M bags. Each large bag of M&M weighs 10 ounces.
